name: webgpu-audio-bridge
description: Schema-driven control-rate-to-audio-rate bridge for the browser. Turbo mode (SAB + Atomics, sub-microsecond push/pull) and Standard mode (MessageChannel, 5-50ms — 0.8.x) share one schema DSL and one frame API. Streams structured frames from a Web Worker (typically WebGPU compute) into an AudioWorklet.
